b:
We just celebrated my son’s birthday at a venue where everything had to be booked and paid for in advance.
I invited 30 kids through Evite and explicitly asked parents to RSVP by November 1.
20 parents RSVP’d, so I paid for 20 kids, including food and party favors.
Guess what? FIVE kids whose parents never RSVP’d showed up anyway.
Obviously, it’s not the kids’ fault, and I felt terrible that I didn’t have enough food or party favors for everyone.
But seriously, what was I supposed to do? Pay for all 30 kids just in case? What’s the point of an RSVP deadline then?!
Should I have communicated better? I don’t get it…
